broadcasts.message: normalize.js remains unchanged and correct. All modules align with spec. No changes needed.

tokenizer.js unchanged and final. It calls injected normalize(text) once, then uses the exact regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g to extract ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes, preserving order and negation. No shadowing. Ready for final integration.

pipeline.js unchanged and final. processText calls tokenize(text), returns exact {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. Frequencies is null-prototype to handle 'constructor' and other prototype names. Unique is first-seen. No shadowing. Ready for integration.

Frequencies uses Object.create(null) to safely handle prototype keys. Unique preserves first-seen order. No shadowing. Final round: keep same code, verify readiness.
